roles.name: Heavy
roles.trick: Rampage (2 Drive): right after taking a hit, make a free Strike at whoever dealt it, if they can reach them

roles.name: Schemer
roles.trick: A mook group acts out of turn (1), tick a villain clock (2)

roles.name: Nemesis
roles.trick: Knows your moves (2 Drive): when the rival spends Drive, the Nemesis has Edge against them until the end of the round

roles.name: Trickster
roles.trick: Swap places with a mook in sight (2), force a reroll (1)

roles.name: Insidious
roles.drive_trigger: A hero takes Stress from them, or goes along with a hook
roles.trick: Whisper (1 Drive): their Presence attack this round goes against every hero who can hear them. Lever (2 Drive): name one of a hero's connections; that hero takes 1 Stress, or has Disadvantage until the end of their next turn

roles.name: Mooks
roles.trick: None. They act in groups of 3.

traits.name: Greed
traits.text: Wants more, whatever it costs other people.
traits.fraying: Protects the money before their people. A hero who threatens the stash or offers a cut has Edge against them.
traits.breaking: Grabs what they can carry and runs, leaving their crew to take the fall.

traits.name: Desperation
traits.text: Has run out of other options: a debt, a deadline, someone held over them.
traits.fraying: Takes any risk to finish the job. Their attacks have Edge, and so do attacks against them.
traits.breaking: Does the one thing they swore they never would: hurts a hostage, lights the fuse, or begs.

traits.name: Narcissism
traits.text: Needs to be admired, and can't stand being laughed at.
traits.fraying: Has to be seen winning. Won't take cover or back off while anyone is watching, and goes after whoever mocks them.
traits.breaking: Drops the plan to humiliate whoever humiliated them, in front of everyone.

traits.name: Lust
traits.text: Wants someone (or wants to own them), and won't take no.
traits.fraying: Fixates on the one they want. Won't harm them, and goes after anyone standing between them.
traits.breaking: Tries to take that person and get out with them. The heroes get one round to stop it.

traits.name: Viciousness
traits.fraying: Goes after the most hurt target in reach, hero or bystander, instead of the biggest threat.
traits.breaking: Hurts whoever is closest and can't fight back, their own people included, until someone stops them.

traits.name: Paranoia
traits.text: Sure that everyone is out to get them, and sometimes right.
traits.fraying: Sees a trap in everything. Keeps a mook group between them and the heroes, and any bluff about backup, cops or a traitor has Edge against them.
traits.breaking: Turns on their own lieutenant or bolts for the nearest exit, certain it's a setup.

traits.name: Envy
traits.text: Wants what someone else has: the fame, the family, the life.
traits.fraying: Goes after the hero who has what they lack and ignores the rest.
traits.breaking: Leaves the fight to wreck something that hero loves. The heroes get one round to stop them.

traits.name: Contempt
traits.text: Thinks the heroes, and most people, are beneath them.
traits.fraying: Won't take the heroes seriously. Toys with the weakest-looking hero instead of the biggest threat.
traits.breaking: Drops the act and throws everything at whoever got under their skin, plan and people be damned.

traits.name: Zealotry
traits.text: Believes in a cause, and that the cause makes them right.
traits.fraying: Can't be talked down or bought: Presence attacks against them have Disadvantage. Won't retreat, either.
traits.breaking: Tries to take everyone down with them for the cause: themselves, their followers, the building.

traits.name: Control
traits.text: Has to run everything and everyone.
traits.fraying: Everything has to go to plan. When a hero changes the fight (a door, the lights, a zone tag), they spend their next turn putting it back.
traits.breaking: Destroys what they can't control any more: the evidence, the building, the hostage. The heroes get one round to stop it.

rules.has: Stats and defenses (same as a hero). Harm: 5 for a lieutenant, 10 for a case's main villain (8 for a smaller one). Stress: 4 boxes for a lieutenant (Fraying at 2, Breaking at 4), 6 for a case villain (Fraying at 3, Breaking at 6). Trait: one line for Fraying and one for Breaking (a hero's Trait, a villain Trait, or their own). Drive: starts at 2, earned from their role trigger once per round. Trick: one special move that costs Drive. Weakness: something the heroes can discover and exploit.
rules.answer_toughness: Every named villain should have at least one way past Toughness: fire, electricity, gas, a hazard they can trigger, or a Presence attack.
rules.presence_attack: Every named villain has a Presence attack (vs Poise, deals Stress). Once per round they can use it as a free extra action.
rules.breaking: A Breaking villain does something reckless: flees, turns on their own people, or gives something away. It does not end the fight: their Breaking line takes over for the rest of the scene, and every attack against them has Edge. If the line says they flee, the heroes get one round to stop them.
rules.named_enemy_resist: A named enemy can lose at most one turn per fight, from all sources combined. After that, any effect that would cost them a turn gives them Disadvantage on their next roll instead. Losing their next Quick Action means Disadvantage on their next roll.

villains.name: The Butcher of Fifth Street

trait.name: Spite
trait.fraying: Goes after whoever hurt him last, plan or no plan.
trait.breaking: Wrecks everything in reach, his own men included.

villains.presence_attack: Free, once per round: +2 vs Poise, 1 Stress per Impact. "I know where you sleep."

tricks.text: Human shield. Redirect a hit to a hostage in his zone.

villains.weakness: Can't turn down a challenge in front of his crew.

villains.name: Augustine Voss, the Landlord

trait.name: Order
trait.fraying: Sticks to the plan even as it falls apart.
trait.breaking: Runs, and sets the building on fire behind him.

villains.drive_trigger: One of his clocks ticks (Eviction, Evidence)
villains.presence_attack: Free, once per round: +3 vs Poise, 1 Stress per Impact. "I own everything you love."

tricks.text: A mook group acts out of turn.

villains.weakness: His handwritten ledger. Without it, his network falls apart.

villains.name: Lieutenant (template)
villains.line: Lieutenant template: adjust stats to fit

mooks.name: Fifth Street Saints
mooks.text: One attack per group per turn, with Edge if all 3 are standing. One in each group carries a pistol (+1 Harm on Impact 2+, ignores Toughness, +1 Heat). They run when half the gang is down, unless a boss is in sight.

mooks.name: Cops
mooks.text: They try to arrest everyone, heroes included.

mooks.name: Bruisers
mooks.text: Tough mooks. One attack per group per turn, with Edge if all 3 are standing. Every 2 Harm drops one, and leftover Harm carries to the next. No Toughness.
